recipes.title: Turkey taco skillet
recipes.summary: 93% turkey browned with onion and pepper, then black beans, salsa, and cumin. Corn tortillas and avocado on the side. Keeper repeat.
steps: Dice the onion and pepper. Drain the beans. Warm tortillas in a dry skillet at the end.
Medium-high skillet, a little oil. Brown the turkey with onion and pepper, breaking it up, 8–10 minutes until no pink.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, a pinch of salt, drained beans, and salsa. Simmer 3 minutes.
Two plates: skillet in tortillas or over them, avocado, cilantro, lime.

recipes.title: Tomato garlic chicken skillet
recipes.summary: Boneless thighs seared, then a quick garlic-tomato pan sauce over whole-wheat pasta. Basil and a little Parmesan to finish. Keeper repeat.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water. Cut thighs into strips. Halve the tomatoes.
Medium-high skillet, a little oil, salt and pepper. Sear chicken until browned and 165°F, about 6 minutes. Pull it out.
Same pan: garlic 30 seconds, then tomatoes until they burst, 4 minutes. Splash of pasta water if it looks dry.
Toss drained pasta and chicken back in. Tear basil over the top and grate Parmesan.

recipes.title: Soy-ginger shrimp stir-fry
recipes.summary: Her plate: EZ-peel shrimp with broccoli, pepper, soy, and ginger over jasmine rice. App swaps chicken onto his plate with the same sides.

ingredients.name: ¾ lb boneless chicken thighs (his plate)

steps: Peel shrimp if needed and pat dry. Cut broccoli into florets and pepper into strips. Mince garlic and ginger. Start the rice pouch.
Hottest skillet, a little oil. Broccoli and pepper 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender. Push aside.
Garlic and ginger 20 seconds. Shrimp in a single layer, 1–2 minutes a side until just opaque.
Splash soy, toss, scatter green onion. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan salmon, beans, and tomatoes
recipes.summary: Her plate: Atlantic salmon roasted with green beans, cherry tomatoes, and lemon. App swaps chicken onto his plate with the same sides.

ingredients.name: ¾ lb boneless chicken thighs (his plate)

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss green beans and tomatoes with oil, smashed garlic, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
Roast vegetables 8 minutes. Push them to the sides.
Oil, salt, and pepper the salmon. Set in the gap. Roast 10–12 minutes until it flakes (145°F).
